restaurantName: Restaurant Corona im Hotel zur Post
bio: It's a real treat to eat here! In this classic restaurant, Sergio and Kerstin Corona work as a well-coordinated team, providing charming service and Mediterranean-inspired cuisine. In addition to the Méditerranée and Corona set menus, from which you can also choose à la carte, there is also a bargain to be had in the three-course lunch menu....
